title: Slow-release pesticide microparticles from polylactic acid and emamectin benzoate: preparation and characteristics
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34948-34959
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03833B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Do Van Cong, Nguyen Vu Giang, Tran Huu Trung, Le Dang Quang, Nguyen Thi Thu Trang, Do Quang Tham, Tran Thi Mai, Nguyen Thi Huong
Emamectin benzoate (EMB) was encapsulated into biodegradable PLA microparticles using dual surfactants, achieving high loading and stability. Encapsulation improved UV/thermal resistance and enabled controlled release for sustainable pest control.
